info.name: Get all currently available latest-version files.

params.name: Folders
params.description: Optional parameter to filter files to specific folders. The list must be in CSV format. If folder contains a comma, make sure to surround it with double quotes. Example: folder1,folder2,"folder,3"

params.name: Fields
params.description:
Optional parameter to filter the top-level fields that are returned. 
The list must be in CSV format. Example: field1,field2,field3

params.name: Limit
params.description: Optional parameter to limit the number of items returned. Default is 200.

params.name: Offset
params.description: Optional parameter to offset the items returned. Default is 0.

items.docs: Get all currently available latest-version files.
